messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Loglikelihood and Information Criteria results
parts: Loglikelihood and Information Criteria results weren't provided.

Those are only available using ML estimation.  If your data are (ordered) categorical, then lavaan will have automatically chosen DWLS estimation instead, which is not likelihood-based and therefore provides neither likelihoods nor information criteria that would be calculated from likelihoods.  See the ?lavInspect help page for ways to ask about your fitted model, for example:

lavInspect(fit, "options")$estimator # the estimation method
lavInspect(fit, "ordered") # the list of ordinal variables, if any

messages.subject: Re: Loglikelihood and Information Criteria results
parts:
> that problem was related to SPSS files and I used a excel file that
> includes same data. The problem was solved.

Just a guess: have you been using the 'haven' package (in RStudio) to
import the SPSS file? In that case, you will get a tibble, not a
data.frame, resulting in NAs for the information criteria. The dev
version of lavaan (0.6-1.something) fixed this.

Yves.
